keyAction.description:
<shortcut>: Presses the shortcut: modifiers and one key joined by +, or a media key like Play/Pause.
hold <shortcut>: Holds the shortcut down while the key is held. A single modifier alone is allowed.
toggle <shortcut>: The first press holds the shortcut down, the next press lets it go (the key's light shows it).
open <app or path>: Opens an app by its name, a program, a file or a folder (see How open finds the app).
<web address>: Opens the page in your web browser. It must start with https:// or http://.
page <name>: Goes to another page. On that page, the same key goes back.
back: Says the key goes back: allowed only on the key that opened this page from another page. It is the same as leaving the key out.
scroll <n>: Scrolls n lines (negative: up). scroll up and scroll down are -1 and 1. n is -100 to 100, not 0.
wheel volume: Turns the wheel into a volume knob until you press the key again.
wheel app volume: Turns the wheel into a volume knob for the app in front.
wheel brightness: Turns the wheel into a brightness knob.
wheel mode <mode>: Switches the wheel to a mode, as pressing SHTL, JOG or SCRL does: jog, scroll, shuttle, volume or brightness.
nothing: The key does nothing (the same as leaving it out). SHTL, JOG and SCRL left unset switch the wheel to their mode.
{ "open": ..., "args": [...], "cwd": ... }: open with arguments and a start folder. open may also be { "windows": ..., "macos": ..., "linux": ... } for one file shared by several computers.

open.description: open with arguments, a start folder or one app per OS.

args.description: Arguments, each passed as it is (no shell).

cwd.description: The folder the app starts in (environment variables and ~ expand).

openTarget.description: An app name, a path (environment variables and ~ expand), a macOS bundle id, a Linux .desktop id, or a web address.

page.description: Key name (see Key names) to what the key does (see Actions). Keys left out are not set. Allowed: key name to action. Default: {}.

wheelAction.description: What one wheel step does: any action except back.

description: What each Speed Editor key, the wheel and the dial do in freewheel. Reference: SCHEMA.md in the freewheel repository.

$schema.description: Where editors find the JSON Schema; freewheel ignores it. Allowed: any URL. Default: (none).

dial.description: How much one wheel step changes while the wheel is a knob. Default: 2, 2, 5.

app_volume_step.description: Percent of the front app's volume per step. Allowed: 0.1 to 100. Default: 2.

brightness_step.description: Percent of display brightness per step. Allowed: 1 to 100. Default: 5.

volume_step.description: Percent of system volume per step. Allowed: 0.1 to 100. Default: 2.

pages.description: Page name to its keys. The first page is where the Speed Editor starts. Allowed: 1 or more pages. Default: one empty page "Base".

settings.description: Optional app settings. Restore changes only the ones written; export never writes them. Default: (your current settings).

appearance.description: The settings window's colours. Allowed: system, light, dark. Default: "system".

detailed_logs.description: Detailed logs for troubleshooting (they turn off after a day). Default: false.

low_battery_warning.description: Warn when the Speed Editor's battery is at or below this percent. Allowed: 0 to 100. Default: 15.

resolve_program.description: The program name freewheel watches for. Allowed: not empty. Default: "Resolve.exe" (Windows), "Resolve" (macOS).

step_aside_for_resolve.description: Turn freewheel off while DaVinci Resolve is open. Default: true.

update_automatically.description: Download new versions by themselves. Default: true.

version.description: The file format. 1 is the long form earlier versions wrote; it still reads. Allowed: 1 or 2. Default: 2.

wheel.description: What turning the wheel does. Default: scroll mode, speed 10.

brightness.description: What turning the wheel does while <mode>'s button is lit. Default: left "scroll up", right "scroll down".

left.description: What one step to the left does. Allowed: any action except back. Default: "scroll up".

max_rate.description: At most this many steps a second (useful for shuttle). Allowed: 1 to 1000. Default: null (no limit).

right.description: What one step to the right does. Allowed: any action except back. Default: "scroll down".

speed.description: This mode's speed, instead of wheel.speed. Allowed: 1 to 10. Default: wheel.speed.
